title: Neural signatures of stress resilience in emotion and cognitive domains: A meta-analysis of task-based fMRI studies
title_zh: 情绪与认知领域中压力韧性的神经特征：基于任务态fMRI的荟萃分析
abstract: Stress resilience, or the ability to maintain mental wellbeing despite major life adversity, is pivotal for the population's mental health. While past evidence suggests stress resilience involves functional adaptations across emotion and cognitive domains, its core neural correlates remain inconsistent across studies. To address the methodological and finding discrepancies, we conducted a pre-registered meta-analysis of 23 task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging studies involving trauma-exposed individuals with varying levels of resilience (N = 1373, 636 females). Resilience was quantified as individuals' post-trauma mental health outcomes. Separate analyses were conducted for the emotion and cognitive domains, while exploratory subgroup and meta-regression analyses were conducted to probe methodological heterogeneities across studies. In the emotion domain, resilience was associated with hypoactivity in the dorsomedial prefrontal cortex, limbic regions and the left lateral temporal cortex. This profile was robustly replicated in studies employing facial stimuli but undetected in non-facial tasks. In the cognitive domain, resilience was characterized by hyperactivity in the ventral prefrontal regions but hypoactivity in dorsal prefrontal, lateral temporal and salience network regions, which was partially replicated within studies employing executive control tasks. Meta-regression analyses further identified study-level moderating effects of age and sex on resilience-related functional activities in the dorsal and medial prefrontal, ventral prefrontal, limbic and temporal regions. Our findings collectively indicate that resilience is associated with higher activities in the ventral prefrontal system but lower activities in limbic and temporal structures. These findings provide insights about neural systems linked to resilience, which contribute to the long-term goal of boosting post-stress mental health.
abstract_zh: 压力韧性（stress resilience）是指在重大生活逆境下仍能维持心理健康的能力，对群体心理健康至关重要。既往证据提示压力韧性涉及情绪与认知领域的功能适应，但其核心神经相关物尚不一致。为解决方法学和结果异质性问题，我们对23项任务态功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究进行了预注册荟萃分析（N=1373，636 名女性），研究对象为有创伤暴露且韧性水平不同的个体。韧性以创伤后心理健康结局量化。我们分别对情绪域与认知域进行分析，并采用探索性亚组与meta回归分析检验研究层面的异质性来源。在情绪域，韧性与背内侧前额叶皮层、边缘系统区域及左侧外侧颞皮层的低活动相关；该特征在采用面孔刺激任务中被稳定复现，但在非面孔任务中未检出。在认知域，韧性表现为腹侧前额叶区域的高活动、但背侧前额叶、外侧颞叶和显著性网络区域的低活动，这在执行控制任务中得到部分复现。元回归进一步指出，年龄和性别在背侧前额叶、内侧前额叶、腹侧前额叶、边缘系统与颞叶等区域的韧性相关功能活动中具有研究水平的调节效应。综合结果表明，韧性与腹侧前额叶系统的更高活动及边缘和颞叶结构的较低活动相关。这些发现提供了与压力韧性相关的神经系统线索，有助于长期促进创伤后心理健康。
